_comment: Windows native messaging host manifest for the MCP broker.
SETUP: Replace PLACEHOLDER_ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_native_host.py with the absolute path to
src\mcp_gateway\host\native_host.py (or a .bat / .exe wrapper) on this machine.
Replace PLACEHOLDER_EXTENSION_ID with the Extension ID shown in chrome://extensions.
INSTALL: Copy this file to a stable location, then add a registry key pointing to it:
Key value: <absolute path to this JSON file>
NOTE (Windows): 'path' must point to a .bat wrapper or python.exe invocation if using a .py script.
name: com.mcp.gemini.broker
description: Google Gemini Notebook MCP Native Messaging Host
